shops.name: Onyx Coffee LAB
shops.blurb: Onyx Coffee Lab is a specialty coffee roastery, located in Rogers, Arkansas. The headquarter is located in an historic building in Downtown Rogers, where every part of their supply chain is showcased.

shops.name: Tim Wendelboe
shops.blurb: Located at Grünersgate 1 at Grünerløkka in Oslo, this espresso bar is visited by locals and tourists from all over the world. Tim Wendelboe is perceived as a coffee showroom where people can be inspired to try something new, or see the world of coffee in a different light.

shops.name: Alquimia Coffee
shops.blurb: ALQUIMIA COFFEE is a world-class specialty coffee shop and roastery in El Salvador, founded by Federico Bolaños, the most successful coach in the history of the World Barista Championship. The purpose of ALQUIMIA COFFEE is to be THE DEFINITIVE COFFEE EXPERIENCE.

shops.name: Only Coffee Project Crows Nest
shops.blurb: Only Coffee Project in Crows Nest is a minimalist espresso bar renowned for its purist approach to specialty coffee, recently recognized as a finalist for Best Coffee in the Good Food 2025 awards. Located at Shop 2/118 Willoughby Rd, Crows Nest, the shop operates Monday to Sunday from 6:30 AM to 3:0

shops.name: Toby’s Estate Coffee Roasters
shops.blurb: Toby’s Estate Flagship Café in Chippendale is an experiential-based venue that focuses on the customer experience and educating people in their coffee journey. Unlike traditional cafes, the Chippendale Flagship breaks down the barriers between the customer and barista.

shops.name: Apartment Coffee
shops.blurb: Born from their belief that anyone can enjoy a good cup of coffee, Apartment Coffee is a Singapore-based coffee studio that is dedicated to sharing exceptional coffee experiences. When it comes to their coffee, their menu mostly offers pour-over options made with single-origin beans from Costa Rica,

shops.name: Gota Coffee Experts
shops.blurb: Gota Coffee is a specialty coffee roastery, located in Vienna, Austria. Whether you are looking for a place to have breakfast, for that perfect espresso to start your day or to experience coffee like never before, you are in the right place.

shops.name: Story of Ono
shops.blurb: ONO is a the World’s First specialty coffee & matcha café that offers a curated selection of premium coffee and matcha, expertly sourced and crafted for a unique, flavorful experience. With a focus on quality and innovation, ONO blends tradition with modern techniques to deliver exceptional beverage

shops.name: Tropicalia Coffee
shops.blurb: By chance, genetics, or magical realism, Arabica coffee chose the Tropics to be planted, and at Tropicalia they chose it to be roasted. shops.name: Tanat
shops.blurb: TANAT Coffee was founded in 2016 with a goal to share the rich experience of specialty coffee with the world. The brand has dedicated itself to perfecting coffee flavours and experimenting with new methods, ultimately developing a roasting style that highlights vibrant, fruity notes.

shops.name: FANKØR
shops.blurb: FANKØR is a specialty coffee roastery and café, accompanied by its own gastronomic offering, which includes cuisine, bakery, and pastry. In every area, they champion the origin and care of the ingredients to guarantee quality, traceability, and a memorable experience.

shops.name: Arcane Estate Coffee
shops.blurb: Arcane is the result of a decade of exploration in Panamanian coffee, motivated by their desire to shorten the distance between the harvest and the cup. shops.name: Beta Coffee
shops.blurb: At Beta Coffee, they are pushing the boundaries of coffee, community, and hospitality by challenging traditional coffee service models. shops.name: Nomadic Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: Nomadic Specialty Coffee is a cornerstone of Cairo’s evolving specialty coffee scene. Driven by a passion for exploration and discovery, they operate as both a high-end roastery and a community-focused café, dedicated to bringing global coffee standards to the heart of Egypt.

shops.name: Nemesis Coffee
shops.blurb: Nemesis is a hospitality driven, specialty coffee company composed of highly dedicated baristas, chefs, and creatives. They utilise their pursuit of passion, and the spaces they explore them in, as a catalyst to build community and create culture.

shops.name: Nomad Frutas Selectas
shops.blurb: Located in the heart of Poblenou, Frutas Selectas by Nomad Coffee is more than just a café—it’s a space designed to celebrate specialty coffee at its finest. With a strong focus on quality and traceability, they serve carefully selected and in-house roasted coffee.

shops.name: Kafi Wasi Café Tostaduría
shops.blurb: Kafi Wasi is a specialty coffee shop that celebrates coffee culture in the heart of Arequipa, just a few blocks from the Plaza de Armas. Founded in 2017 by Diego Cisneros and Pamela Reymer, it combines passion and tradition in every cup, offering a unique experience for coffee lovers.

shops.name: Benchmark Coffee
shops.blurb: Benchmark Coffee redefines the specialty café experience in Sharjah’s new heart, Al Jada. Located on East Boulevard and Naseej South, this all-comers’ community hotspot offers excellent coffee in a relaxed atmosphere.

shops.name: Hola Coffee Lagasca
shops.blurb: Hola Coffee Lagasca stands out for its minimalist but colorful design, offering their own roasted coffee with expert and friendly service. Their selection of filter coffees and signature drinks showcases a high level of innovation and quality.

shops.name: BlendIn Coffee Club
shops.blurb: Blendin Coffee Club is a Houston based specialty coffee company dedicated to sourcing, roasting, and serving some of the world’s most exceptional coffees. Through direct producer partnerships and a hospitality driven café experience, Blendin connects coffee communities from origin to cup.

shops.name: Holaste! Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: Holaste! is a specialty coffee shop and roastery located in the city center of Puerto Natales, Magallanes Region, one of the southernmost regions in the world!

shops.name: Momos Coffee Flagship Store
shops.blurb: MOMOS Coffee is a specialty coffee roastery founded in Busan, South Korea, in 2007. shops.name: Monotono Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: Monótono Specialty Coffee is a minimalist specialty coffee shop nestled in the heart of Barranco, Lima. Known for its smooth espresso and filter brews — including Geisha from San Ignacio — Monótono combines precision brewing with a calm, focused atmosphere.

shops.name: Ult Coffee
shops.blurb: The ULT Coffee Roaster store is located in Osaka, Japan, and was founded by World Barista Champion Boram Um. ULT is a Japan-based specialty coffee brand focused on competition-level coffees and carefully selected micro-lots, inviting customers into a terroir-driven coffee experience.

shops.name: El Injerto
shops.blurb: In the mountains of the western highlands, where cloud forests and unique microclimates create exceptional conditions, lies Finca El Injerto, a coffee farm with over 150 years of history that has taken Guatemala’s name to the pinnacle of specialty coffee. Founded in 1874 by Jesús Aguirre Panamá, the

shops.name: Three Monkeys Coffee
shops.blurb: Three Monkeys Coffee in Cusco redefines specialty coffee with an innovative and technical approach in their processes. Located centrally, their café blends tradition with avant-garde, emphasizing quality control from their precision-cultivated farm.

shops.name: Proud Mary Coffee
shops.blurb: Proud Mary Café in Melbourne is a pioneer in the Australian coffee scene and a must-visit for coffee lovers and food enthusiasts. Known for its exceptional coffee program, the café takes pride in sourcing high quality coffees through longstanding producer relationships, delivering magic in every cup

shops.name: Koffee Mameya Kakeru
shops.blurb: KOFFEE MAMEYA Kakeru provides an extraordinary coffee experience. It is unlike the style of ordinary coffee shop offerings of the past, their experience is as if you went to a restaurant to enjoy the chef’s carefully selected ingredients and techniques.

shops.name: Coffee Anthology
shops.blurb: Coffee Anthology is a specialty coffee shop located in Brisbane, Australia. Customers claim it’s the best spot to enjoy a great breakfast in Brisbane.

shops.name: 7g Roaster
shops.blurb: 7 Gaia Roaster, established in 2017, has become a reference specialty coffee roaster, democratizing traceable and ethically sourced coffee. Their name, «7», reflects the number of apartments within their space, while «Gaia» denotes their location near the Gaia quay.

shops.name: Espresso Alchemy
shops.blurb: Espresso Alchemy is a specialty coffee roastery and café chain in Hong Kong, China. Known for sourcing exceptional beans directly from award-winning producers in Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, and Indonesia, the brand fosters ethical and sustainable coffee production within their direct trade program.

shops.name: Coffeewerk + Press
shops.blurb: Since opening their little yellow door in 2015, coffee has been at the heart of everything they do at Coffeewerk + Press. As a multi-roaster café, they’ve had the privilege of collaborating with over 80 local and international coffee roasters.

shops.name: Typica Café
shops.blurb: Typica Café is a specialty coffee roastery located in La Paz, Bolivia. Typica Tostaduría is the space where this company focuses on seeking out coffee growers committed to producing the finest Bolivian specialty coffees and to continually enhancing the value of the national product.

shops.name: Yardstick
shops.blurb: Yardstick has been a specialty coffee roaster since 2013. They create spaces and experiences for everyone to enjoy the coffee that they roast.

shops.name: Histórico
shops.blurb: Histórico café y tostador is a space dedicated to Chiapas coffee from its origin. Located in San Cristóbal de las Casas, it is part of Finca Hamburgo (founded in 1888) and represents the urban continuity of its coffee legacy, connecting land, history, and cup in a single experience.

shops.name: Coffee Sind
shops.blurb: Located in Taipei, Coffee Sind is devoted to serving high-quality coffee in a lifestyle-inspired way, offering every coffee lover a truly great cup. Friendliness, simplicity, and convenience define Coffee Sind’s unique character amid the fast-paced rhythm of Taipei.

shops.name: DeLafinca Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: Delafinca Specialty Coffee is a Nicaraguan coffee brand born from a passion for quality and a commitment to sustainability. Founded in 2012, Delafinca Specialty Coffee cultivates its beans in the mountains of San Juan de Río Coco, Madriz, ensuring comprehensive control from seed to cup.

shops.name: Ottoman Coffee House
shops.blurb: A multi-roaster coffee sanctuary in Glasgow’s West End, featuring a rotating lineup of the best roasters and a full spectrum of brew methods, from rich Ibrik and espresso beverages to meticulously crafted pour-overs. shops.name: Casa Canela
shops.blurb: Casa Canela is a specialty coffee shop in Caracas, Venezuela, that began as an innovative business concept during the Pandemic, initially focused on baking supplies. However, their passion for coffee led them to transform into a haven for specialty coffee lovers.

shops.name: Espresso LAB
shops.blurb: Espressolab is a specialty coffee roastery based in Cape Town, South Africa. They have been roasting small boutique batches of coffee since 2009, and were one of the pioneers of the specialty coffee movement both locally and internationally.

shops.name: Seven Mystery
shops.blurb: SEVEN MYSTERY is a specialty coffee roastery based in Toronto, Canada. Founded on a commitment to quality, precision, and long-term consistency, they work closely with cafés and partners through their roasting facility, offering thoughtfully developed coffees and refined roasting solutions.

shops.name: Faro
shops.blurb: Faro – Caffè Specialty was founded in 2016 with the desire to spread the culture of specialty coffee, enhancing its supply chain and consumption methods. shops.name: Domestique
shops.blurb: Domestique Coffee is a specialty coffee roastery located in Birmingham, Alabama, USA. Domestique is a coffee, hospitality, and lifestyle company that offers cultural experiences centered around coffee.

shops.name: Harvest Coffee
shops.blurb: Harvest Coffee is an award-winning, Qatar-born specialty coffee house, founded in Doha in 2019. They are known for leading innovative coffee experiences; where every detail is intentional, from the cup to the space.

shops.name: Origen Tostadores de Café
shops.blurb: Origen Tostadores de Café has proudly served Peru for twelve years, maintaining a strong commitment to their founding principles. Every year, they prioritize direct engagement with their coffee producers by closing their shops and taking their team to the farms.

shops.name: KEEP Coffee Roastery
shops.blurb: KEEP Coffee Roastery is a community-focused coffee roastery and group of cafés in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. They prioritize sweetness in coffee, with a dedicated focus on maintaining a clean cup—qualities that can be found in both their beans and their brewed coffee.

shops.name: Meet LAB Coffee
shops.blurb: Founded in Istanbul in 2016, Meet Lab Coffee blends quality coffee with exceptional service, enhancing coffee culture through unique experiences. They create a warm, minimalist atmosphere, fostering connection among coffee lovers.

shops.name: Mulano Coffee Shop
shops.blurb: Eli Romero, a professional SCA barista, founded and inaugurated Mulano Coffee Shop in 2022. This café is located in the south of Ecuador in a city of 25,000 inhabitants called Piñas, making it the first specialty coffee shop in the Province of El Oro.

shops.name: La Cabra
shops.blurb: La Cabra Coffee is a modern coffee company, located in Copenhagen, Denmark. Curious about what lay further down the coffee chain, they threw themselves into sourcing and roasting their own coffee, their own way, in 2013.

shops.name: Birch Coffee
shops.blurb: Birch is a specialty coffee shop, bakery, and brunch spot based in Portree on the Isle of Skye, with a second location in Inverness. shops.name: Ruli Coffee
shops.blurb: RULICOFFEE is a specialty coffee shop located near Myeong-dong, Seoul, offering over 100 high-end Panamanian coffees. They consistently carry more than 20 ultra-premium auction lots, including selections from Best of Panama (BOP).

shops.name: Atte For Coffee
shops.blurb: Atte Coffee is a Slow Coffee Bar—gratitude in the form of a cup… and also in the form of a shared table. They believe in the value of things well done: carefully selected coffees, prepared with respect, and homemade desserts born from their culinary training and love for the craft.

shops.name: Single O
shops.blurb: Single O is a pioneer of the Australian specialty coffee scene, located in the heart of Surry Hills, Sydney. Since 2003, they have been at the forefront of sourcing and roasting, driven by a mission to celebrate the distinct «single origin» characteristics of every bean.

shops.name: Rubia Coffee Roasters
shops.blurb: Rubia Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roastery, café and education hub in Kigali, Rwanda, founded in 2016 by Mbonyi Kalisa Mathias. Its mission: to champion specialty coffee culture at origin — in the country where the coffee grows.

shops.name: Bob Coffee Lab
shops.blurb: BOB Coffee has set the standard in the Romanian specialty coffee market with its roastery and a chain of coffee shops in Bucharest. With an excellent, award-winning product, roasted by world champion Alex Niculae in 2016, BOB Coffee is one of the hottest coffee locations in Europe.

shops.name: Unfiltered coffee
shops.blurb: Founded in 2019, Unfiltered Coffee in Dublin is a study in precision and restraint. A small, minimalist space devoted entirely to craft, they approach coffee with the philosophy of fine dining — where every variable is intentional and every detail matters.

shops.name: Tomorrow Coffee Roasters
shops.blurb: Tomorrow Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee studio from Taichung, Taiwan, born from a fashion buyer-store and design background. They curate rare single-origin coffees from global award-winning farms and express them through precise roasting, refined brewing, and minimalist visual storytelling.

shops.name: Ca Passe Creme

shops.name: Eco Mapu
shops.blurb: Ecomapu Coffee is an innovative and experimental specialty coffee shop. They fuse high-quality coffee with traditional flavors from Southern Chile, offering a unique and creative experience.

shops.name: 43.12 Coffee
shops.blurb: 43.12 Câfe is a specialty coffee and brunch spot located in the heart of Varna. The name comes from the câfe’s coordinates, 43-12.

shops.name: Fika & Co. Cafe
shops.blurb: Fika & Co. is a prominent Bangkok-based coffee shop and roastery, operating branches at the Singha Complex and Sukhumvit 62.

shops.name: Ditta Artigianale Specialty Coffee Roasters
shops.blurb: The first Ditta Artigianale coffee shop in Milan — a specialty café in the heart of the city where you can experience high-quality coffee in a warm and contemporary setting. Their mission at Ditta Artigianale is to bring exceptional coffee to Italy and share its story in a new and transparent way.

shops.name: Café Nativo
shops.blurb: Café Nativo & Roastery is a 100% Honduran company with 9 years in the coffee industry, dedicated to preserving heritage while embracing innovation. shops.name: Kross Coffee Roasters
shops.blurb: Kross Coffee Roasters is the first of 6 Kross locations. They opened doors in August 2015, adjacently to one of the two historic mosques in the old town of Chania.

shops.name: Prevail Coffee
shops.blurb: Prevail Coffee is a craft coffee roaster and micro-importer located in the heart of the Deep South. They strive to be a quality connector for authentic community, and they are honored to do so alongside their talented producers and friends from around the globe.

shops.name: MOK Coffee
shops.blurb: Founded in 2012 by Jens Crabbé, MOK COFFEE is both a roastery and a café. They are proud to have two-time Belgian Cuptasters champions on their team, and this year, Marlies, one of their baristas, won the Brewers Cup.

shops.name: Azura – The Coffee Company
shops.blurb: Azura is a specialty coffee brand from Oman built on the foundation of hospitality. In their culture, welcoming someone means offering your best, and that philosophy shapes everything they do.

shops.name: Puku Puku
shops.blurb: Puku Puku is a 100% Peruvian specialty coffee chain that originated as a sustainable and everyday space for seeking an escape from urban life. Everything they do revolves around coffee and small entrepreneurs.

shops.name: The Golden Pig
shops.blurb: At The Golden Pig, every cup of coffee they serve tells a story. They work closely with producers from the best coffee-growing regions, ensuring quality in every bean that is roasted by them.

shops.name: Little Victories Coffee
shops.blurb: Little Victories Coffee is a small, independent specialty coffee roaster based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada that was co-founded by two coffee professionals – one roaster and one barista. The company operates 3 cafés and a bustling wholesale & web operation.

shops.name: Push Pull
shops.blurb: PUSH PULL focuses on naturals, honeys, anaerobics, and the most experimental and fruity coffees they can find. What they do and who they are is about people.

shops.name: Galani Coffee
shops.blurb: Wanting to bring the future and the past together, Galani coffee combined the excellence of Ethiopian coffee with the modern understanding and setting. GALANI means blue in Greek and Ocean in Oromifa.

shops.name: Wake up
shops.blurb: From Punta Arenas, Chile, at the end of the world, Wake Up Coffee takes the passion for specialty coffee to another level. Founded in 2017, Wake Up strives and works to offer an experience with a global character, where every detail counts and every cup has a story.

shops.name: Bouche
shops.blurb: Bouche is a specialty coffee brand dedicated to sharing great coffee with local and international communities in Brussels. They are committed to quality in every aspect of their business and have challenged themselves to doing things in their own way.

shops.name: Café de Reyes
shops.blurb: Café de Reyes, located in Quetzaltenango, Guatemala, offers specialty coffee accompanied by signature drinks and a menu featuring sourdough bread and desserts. Its open bar allows you to learn about the coffee process, while the space provides cozy environments to enjoy and share.

shops.name: Savaya Coffee Market
shops.blurb: Savaya has cultivated strong relationships with leading coffee professionals, from researchers to farmers and roasters, emphasizing both innovation and respect for coffee’s rich history. They are committed to direct sourcing, building personal connections with the farms that provide their beans.

shops.name: Coffee Stopover Black
shops.blurb: Coffee Stopover, located in Taichung, Taiwan, is a specialty coffee brand dedicated to the craft of roasting. Established in 2015.

shops.name: Fuku
shops.blurb: FUKU Café is a specialty coffee shop located in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. Open 7 days a week, Fuku defines itself as a place where there’s always great coffee, friendly people, and sometimes even natural wine.

shops.name: The Miners Coffee
shops.blurb: From Prague, shaping coffee culture globally. At The Miners, coffee fuels ambition.

shops.name: Cupping Café
shops.blurb: In the heart of Vila Madalena, São Paulo, Cupping Café is the perfect spot for those who love taking a moment to enjoy a real cup of coffee! Since 2017, their mission has been serving the best coffee, made with carefully selected beans from all over Brazil, signature roasting, and perfect grinding.

shops.name: Coffea Guatemala
shops.blurb: Coffea Cafes Especiales is a specialty coffee shop & roastery located in the heart of Antigua Guatemala. Coffea sources coffee from small local farmers through all the regions of Guatemala.

shops.name: D•Origen Coffee Roasters Barcelona
shops.blurb: D·Origen is undoubtedly a gem in the heart of Barcelona’s Eixample district. shops.name: Coffee Stain
shops.blurb: Since 2012, Coffee Stain Malaysia has been redefining the coffee experience. Every cup reflects careful sourcing, innovative processing, and precise brewing, guided by a deep respect for the bean’s origin.

shops.name: The Dude Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: The Dude is one of the pioneers of Macedonia’s budding specialty coffee scene which has featured coffee from multiple roasters over the past few years. This cozy coffee shop near Skopje’s bustling city center is located in a restored house, where each room has a unique atmosphere.

shops.name: Story and Soil Coffee
shops.blurb: At Story and Soil Coffee, they love coffee and its capacity to bring out the best in people. They enjoy showcasing exceptional coffees and roasters that highlight the work of producers, farmers, and baristas.

shops.name: Exploradores
shops.blurb: Unlike traditional cafés that primarily focus on atmosphere or brewing technique, Exploradores de Café was born from a passion for the science and sustainability of coffee production. Here, specialty coffee is not just served — it is explained, experienced, and honored.

shops.name: The Folks
shops.blurb: Established in Lisbon in 2022, The Folks has rapidly grown into a network of six inviting cafés across Portugal, complemented by their own dedicated roastery, also located in Lisbon. shops.name: Casa Barista & Co.,Casco Historico
shops.blurb: Casa Barista & Co. was founded in 2018 in the Dominican Republic with the mission of driving and transforming specialty coffee culture in the country.

shops.name: Cypher Urban Roastery
shops.blurb: Cypher Urban Roastery is a specialty coffee house and roasting lab built on precision, passion, and personality. From sourcing exceptional green coffees to profiling and roasting in-house, Cypher is dedicated to delivering bold, clean, and expressive cups that showcase origin at its finest.

shops.name: Cafetano Coffee Roasters

shops.name: Coffee Five

shops.name: Kima Coffee
shops.blurb: Kima Coffee is a specialty coffee shop and roastery in Malaga, dedicated to providing an exceptional experience for lovers of good coffee. They carefully select the best single-origin Arabica coffee beans, which they roast with precision to highlight their most complex and refined flavor profiles.

shops.name: Negro
shops.blurb: Negro Cueva de Café was founded in 2015 with the purpose of providing a new and pleasant experience to the Buenos Aires public, becoming the first specialty coffee bar in the downtown area of Buenos Aires. shops.name: Metric
shops.blurb: Metric is a specialty coffee roastery based in Chicago, Illinois. Its headquarters houses the core of the company’s work—green coffee sourcing and evaluation, sample roasting, full-scale production roasting, quality control, and education—under one roof.

shops.name: El Terrible Juan Café
shops.blurb: El Terrible Juan Café was founded in 2015 with the firm intention of showcasing the quality of Mexican coffee in every cup. It’s a coffee shop focused on high-quality coffees, where they also serve baked goods and pastries.

shops.name: Flat White Specialty Coffee
shops.blurb: Flat White Specialty Coffee began when Nasser Al-Naemi and Maryam Al-Bader turned their lifelong love of coffee into a shared mission. Their goal was to bring Specialty Coffee and Third Wave culture to Qatar.

shops.name: Cafeoteca
shops.blurb: Cafeoteca, located in San Jose, Costa Rica, is a specialty coffee roastery dedicated to the art and education of coffee. shops.name: Brew Lab

shops.blurb: Paper Mill is a specialty coffee roastery and a bakery with three cafés in Tallinn. shops.name: Ripsnorter Coffee Roasters
